access.title: No access to PPE for workers
access.body: This page needs the right to see safety (safety.view). Ask whoever manages roles in your company.

common.noneFilteredHint: Change or clear the filters to see more.

band.label: PPE actions
band.printReceiptsHint: Opens Issues: choose the lines, then Print receipts.
band.exportLater: Later: these lists have no export yet.

peopleMissingKit.label: People missing kit items
peopleMissingKit.hint: At least one item of their role's kit not handed over

receiptsNotSigned.label: Receipts not signed
receiptsNotSigned.hint: Paper receipts whose signed scan is not on file

replacementsDue.label: Replacements due
replacementsDue.hint: People with a unit past its life (months)

law.receipt: PPE kept efficient, instructions given, the receipt

roleBanner.title_one: The kit for {role} changed: {count} person misses items of it
roleBanner.title_other: The kit for {role} changed: {count} people miss items of it
roleBanner.body: The role sheet was changed. Gaps were read again.

gaps.title: Gaps per person
gaps.label: Gaps per person
gaps.withoutRole_one: {count} person has no role yet: their kit is unknown.
gaps.withoutRole_other: {count} people have no role yet: their kit is unknown.
gaps.moreHeld: Only the first 2000 people are read: choose a site or a role.

empty.replace: No unit is past its life.
empty.all: No one works at this site yet.

emptyHint.missing: Each person's role kit is handed over in full.
emptyHint.replace: Every unit in use is within its life.
emptyHint.all: People appear here once they are in People › Employees.

issues.title: Issues and receipts
issues.label: Issues and receipts
issues.addScanOf: Add the signed scan of {name}'s receipt
issues.empty: No issues yet. Issues are usually signed on the floor tablet.
issues.moreHeld: Only the newest 500 lines are read: choose a person, an item or the receipts not signed.

kits.title: Kits per role
kits.label: Kits per role
kits.readHere: Read here; edited in the role sheet.
kits.riskLater: Read here; edited in the role sheet of the risk assessment.
kits.noRoles: No active role sheet at this site
kits.noKits: No role names a PPE item yet
kits.emptyHint: Open the risk assessment to give each role its kit.
kits.emptyHintLater: Each role's kit is set in its role sheet, in the risk assessment.
kits.moreHeld: Only the first roles are read: choose a site.

catalogue.title: Catalogue
catalogue.label: PPE catalogue
catalogue.categoryHint: I minimal risks, II, III deadly or irreversible risks (Regulation (EU) 2016/425)
catalogue.costHidden: Unit costs need the cost right (money.cost).
catalogue.empty: Start from the items a leather and garment workshop usually hands out, then adjust them.
catalogue.moreHeld: Only the first 500 items are read: search for the one you want.

issue.title: Issue PPE
issue.personHint: Everyone who works at the site, with their role.
issue.personPlaceholder: Type a name or a number
issue.noRole: No role yet: their kit is unknown. Choose the items yourself.
issue.choosePerson: Choose the person first: their missing kit items come in by themselves.
issue.kitComplete: They have their whole kit: add an item if one is lost or worn.
issue.noRoleLines: Add the items you hand over.
issue.itemGone: Item no longer in the catalogue

lineProblem.ppeItemId: This item is not in the person's company catalogue, or it is archived.
lineProblem.line: One line per item and size.

issue.paperHint: The person signs the printed receipt; you record it now and add the scan of the signed paper.
issue.tabletHint: The person signs with their own badge and PIN at a tablet of their site.
issue.signedAtHint: When the person signed the paper. Leave it empty: now.
issue.scanHint: The signed paper: a PDF or a photo (JPG, PNG), up to 20 MB. It can be added later from Issues.
issue.tabletSteps: Ask the person to go to a tablet of {site}: Training & PPE sign-off › Receive PPE. They scan their badge, check the items and sign with their own PIN.
issue.tabletNothing: Nothing is recorded here: the receipt is made at the tablet when the person signs. The tablet offers their missing kit items.
issue.readFailed: Couldn't read the people or the items.
issue.scanNotTaken: The signed scan was not taken: the receipt counts as not signed.
issue.scanQuarantined: The file was set aside by the virus check: add another scan from Issues.
issue.scanLater: Add the signed scan later from Issues: Add scan.

item.title: PPE item
item.codeHint: Kept in capitals: {code}. It never changes once made.
item.name: Name
item.nameLangHint: Shown to people reading in that language; empty: the name.
item.categoryHint: Regulation (EU) 2016/425. Category III asks for training (art. 77 c.5).
item.standardHint: As on the item's declaration, e.g. EN 388:2016.
item.sizesHint: Each size once; none: one size.
item.lifeHint: Replaced after this many months; empty: when worn.
item.supplierHint: Active suppliers of the company and the group.
item.supplierNoRight: Choosing a supplier needs the chemical register's right (safety.chemicals.manage); the item keeps its supplier.
item.noKits: No active role's kit names it.
item.inKitHeld: A role kit still names this item ({roles}): take it out of the role sheets first.
item.archived: This item is archived: it is no longer handed out. Put it back in use to change it.

void.title: Void an issue
void.stays: The line stays on its receipt with a void mark and the reason.
void.holds: The person no longer holds it: their gaps are counted again.
void.never: Nothing is deleted, and a void cannot be undone: hand the item over again if needed.
void.reasonHint: Why this issue is wrong (it is kept with the void).

scan.title: Add the signed scan
scan.why: The signed paper is the receipt's legal record (art. 77 c.4): once its scan is on file the receipt counts as signed.

archive.kept: Archived items are kept with every issue; they are no longer handed out. An item a role kit names cannot be archived.

notice.tablet: Ask {name} to sign at a tablet of {site} (Training & PPE sign-off › Receive PPE).
notice.issued_one: Receipt of {name} recorded with its signed scan: {count} item.
notice.issued_other: Receipt of {name} recorded with its signed scan: {count} items.
notice.issuedNoScan_one: Receipt of {name} recorded: {count} item. It counts as not signed until its scan is added (Issues).
notice.issuedNoScan_other: Receipt of {name} recorded: {count} items. It counts as not signed until its scan is added (Issues).
notice.voided: The line of {name} was voided; the receipt keeps it with a void mark.
notice.scanned: The signed scan of {name}'s receipt is on file.
notice.commonSome_one: {count} common item added; the company already had {skipped}.
notice.commonSome_other: {count} common items added; the company already had {skipped}.

saved.archived: Archived: it is no longer handed out.

held.issue: Your role does not record PPE receipts (safety.ppe.issue).
held.manage: Your role does not keep the PPE catalogue (safety.ppe.manage).
held.company: Choose a company in the top bar first.
held.personSite: This person works where your role does not record receipts.
held.tabletNotReady: The floor tablet's Receive PPE screen is not ready yet: record a paper receipt.
held.tooManyLines: At most 20 lines on one receipt.
held.itemsLoading: The catalogue is still being read.

line.ppeItemId: An item is not in the person's company catalogue, or it is archived.

held.lineTwice: One line per item and size.
held.signedAt: Choose when the paper was signed.
held.scanType: The scan is a PDF or a photo (JPG, PNG).
held.scanFile: Choose the scan of the signed paper.
held.scanDone: This receipt is no longer waiting for its scan.
held.upload: Your role does not upload files (files.upload): the receipt is recorded as not signed; someone who uploads files adds the scan from Issues.
held.readFiles: Your role does not open stored files (files.read).
held.code: Type the code: capitals, digits and . _ / - (no spaces).
held.name: Type the name.
held.standard: The standard in words, up to 120 characters.
held.sizes: Each size once, up to 20 characters each.
held.lifeMonths: The life is 1 to 120 months (empty: when worn).
held.supplierPartyId: Choose a supplier from the list.
held.noneArchivable: Choose at least one item in use.
held.reason: Say why this issue is wrong.
held.lineGone: This line is no longer in the list: read it again.

refusal.CODE_TAKEN: Another PPE item already has this code.
refusal.ARCHIVED: This PPE item is archived: put it back in use first.
refusal.NOT_ARCHIVED: This PPE item is not archived.
refusal.IN_KIT: A role kit still names this item: take it out of the role sheets first.
refusal.SUPPLIER_NOT_FOUND: This supplier cannot be named: choose an active supplier of the company or the group.
refusal.ITEM_NOT_AVAILABLE: This item is not in the person's company catalogue, or it is archived.
refusal.SIZE_UNKNOWN: Choose one of the item's sizes (a one-size item takes none).
refusal.NOT_ACTIVE: This person no longer works here: PPE is handed only to people who work for the company.
refusal.NO_EMPLOYEE: This floor sign-in is not linked to a person's record.
refusal.OTHER_COMPANY: This person works for another company than this site's.
refusal.SAME_TIME: A receipt of this person is already recorded at that time: change the time by a minute.
refusal.TOO_LATE: A paper receipt is recorded within 366 days of the day it was signed.
refusal.IN_FUTURE: A receipt is never dated in the future.
refusal.PAPER_RECEIPT: A paper receipt is its signed scan: the PDF is kept for receipts signed with badge and PIN.
refusal.NOT_PPE_STEP: This leaver step is not "PPE returned".
refusal.NOT_HELD: Name an issue of this person that is not voided.

problem.read: The server did not answer as expected. Try again in a moment.
problem.invalid: Something in the form is not right.
problem.signedOut: You are signed out: sign in again.
problem.forbidden: Your role does not allow this.
problem.notFound: Not found: it may have been removed, or it is not in your reach.
problem.conflict: Someone changed it meanwhile: read it again.
problem.rateLimited: Too many requests: wait a moment.
problem.noAnswer: No answer: check the network. It may have been saved — read the list again before trying.
problem.unavailable: The server is not available. Try again in a moment.
problem.internal: Something went wrong on the server.
problem.file: The file could not be opened.

keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.lenses: Gaps, Issues, Kits per role, Catalogue

receipt.title: PPE receipt of {name}, {date}
receipt.held: The receipt is still being read.
receipt.notSigned: Paper receipt, scan not on file yet
receipt.verified: Verified: the signature's fingerprint matches what was handed over and the statement signed.
receipt.notVerified: Not verified: the fingerprint does not match these lines; check the receipt with the safety officer.
receipt.scanMissing: Not signed yet: add the scan of the signed paper from Issues.
receipt.allVoided: Every line of this receipt is voided.
receipt.kept: Kept in the person's file as version {version} ({date}).
receipt.keptSame: Already kept as version {version} ({date}): the same contents.
receipt.preview: A preview made now and stored nowhere; Keep the PDF stores it with the person's receipts.

card.notActive: This person no longer works here.
card.noKit: No role yet: the kit is unknown.
card.emptyKit: This role's kit names no PPE.
card.returnedOpen: Leaving: PPE still to be returned.
